page.overview:
Who is Nuakan?

Nuakan is a tall and strong man, and despite his bulk, he has great stamina and is able to move at high speed. His special move is an invincible knee kick named the .

Nuakan was born in a poor village, but following a harsh training led him to become a legend known as the Emperor of Muay Thai. He often confronts other warriors, taking them down. One day, a young Sagat challenged him in the Khmer Ruins and managed to win, gaining his title of the Emperor of Muay Thai.
